create_cached_remote_filesystem: create a CachedRemoteFileSystem instance wrapping an fsspec filesystem with a remote URI for global caching
find_cached_files: find all files below a path using cached data from the CachedRemoteFileSystem to avoid redundant API calls
ls_directory_cached: list directory contents with cached file stats using the ls method on CachedRemoteFileSystem
get_file_info_cached: get file info using cached stats for size and mode via the info method on CachedRemoteFileSystem
open_file_with_locking: open a remote file with per-file locking to prevent concurrent download race conditions using CachedRemoteFileSystem
